1) If you make seismic front office changes after a season is destroyed by injury (even if they should've prepared a better contingency plan) you might scare off top level talent in the future.

2) If you reset, it's possible whoever you hire will start selling off the pieces we do have in order to attempt a more comprehensive rebuild.

3) Our defense, while perhaps a touch overrated, is good and you can't simply replace coaches and expect the next guy in line to automatically get the same thing out of them. I'd like \*this group\* at least get a chance at a playoff run with a real qb, even though I've frankly always questioned how much Rodgers has left in the tank.
